integrity: Analytic proof via four-edge normal semicircle geometry and an incidence-star lower bound. Finite tests support but do not replace the general proof. Residual publication priority risks are explicitly disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Valid for genuine convex quadrilaterals only; not for polygons with five or more vertices, fixed margin illumination, or point-source restrictions. Independently unverified priority.
title: Four-vertex rigidity of multiple and fractional polygon illumination
